# Tanod Tools

> 150+ free tools for PDFs, images, text, code, e-invoices, aviation and MikroTik routers, in 12 languages. Most run entirely in the browser, so files never leave the device; no signup. Operated by an autonomous AI agent. Paid API and MCP versions of the PDF, image and document tools: https://tanod.dev/llms.txt

## Tools

- [Add a watermark to a PDF](https://tanod.dev/tools/watermark-pdf/): Add a text watermark such as DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL to a PDF in your browser. Set size, colour, opacity, angle and tiling. Free, no signup, files stay on your device.
- [Add border to image](https://tanod.dev/tools/add-border-to-image/): Frame photos with a coloured border, inner padding and rounded corners in pixels or percent. Transparent corners for PNG and WebP. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Add page numbers to a PDF](https://tanod.dev/tools/add-page-numbers-to-pdf/): Add page numbers to a PDF in your browser. Choose the position, format and starting number, skip the cover, and download. Free, no signup, files stay on your device.
- [Add text to image](https://tanod.dev/tools/add-text-to-image/): Write a caption or watermark on a photo: choose font, size, colour, outline, shadow and background box, and place it by tapping the preview. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Age calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/age-calculator/): Work out an exact age in years, months and days from a date of birth, on today's date or any other. Totals in months, weeks and days, plus the next birthday.
- [Aspect ratio calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/aspect-ratio-calculator/): Find the aspect ratio of any width and height, and work out a new width or height that keeps the same ratio. Presets for 16:9, 4:3, 21:9, 1:1 and more.
- [Aurora visibility estimator](https://tanod.dev/tools/aurora-visibility-estimator/): Enter a Kp index and your location to estimate whether the northern or southern lights could be visible overhead or on the horizon, using geomagnetic latitude.
- [Aviation unit converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/aviation-unit-converter/): Convert aviation units: knots, km/h, mph and m/s; hPa, inHg and mmHg; feet, metres, nautical and statute miles; and °C, °F and kelvin.
- [Barcode generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/barcode-generator/): Make barcodes in Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 39, ITF-14, Codabar and more, with check digits calculated. Download SVG or PNG. Free, in your browser.
- [Base64 encode and decode](https://tanod.dev/tools/base64-encode-decode/): Encode text or any file to Base64 and decode Base64 back to text or a file. Handles UTF-8, URL-safe Base64 and data URLs, all in your browser. Free, no upload.
- [BMI calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/bmi-calculator/): Work out body mass index from weight and height in metric or imperial units, see the WHO adult category and the weight range for your height. Screening only.
- [Business days calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/business-days-calculator/): Count business days between two dates or add and subtract working days. Choose your weekend, count or skip the end dates and list holidays. Free, in your browser.
- [Case converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/case-converter/): Change text to UPPER CASE, lower case, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more. Free, in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Character counter](https://tanod.dev/tools/character-counter/): Count characters with and without spaces, letters and UTF-8 bytes as you type, and see what is left for an X post, SMS, title tag or meta description.
- [chmod calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/chmod-calculator/): Tick read, write and execute boxes to get the chmod octal number, the rwxr-xr-x form and ready commands, or type a mode to see the boxes. Covers setuid and sticky.
- [Color contrast checker](https://tanod.dev/tools/color-contrast-checker/): Check the WCAG contrast ratio of text on a background from HEX, RGB, HSL or a CSS name, with AA and AAA results for normal and large text. Free, in your browser.
- [Color converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/color-converter/): Convert colours between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV and CMYK, look up CSS colour names, and check the WCAG contrast ratio of text on a background. Free, in your browser.
- [Color palette generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/color-palette-generator/): Pick a base colour and get analogous, complementary, triadic, tetradic and monochromatic palettes with contrast ratios and export. Free, runs in your browser.
- [Compare text (diff checker)](https://tanod.dev/tools/text-diff/): Compare two texts and see what was added and removed, by line, word or character, side by side or inline. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Compound interest calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/compound-interest-calculator/): Compound interest calculator with regular monthly contributions: final balance, interest earned and a year-by-year table. Free, in your browser.
- [Compress image](https://tanod.dev/tools/compress-image/): Make JPEG, PNG and WebP images smaller in your browser. Set the quality, optionally reduce PNG colours, and see the size saved. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Compress PDF](https://tanod.dev/tools/compress-pdf/): Make a PDF file smaller for email or upload. Real compression: photos are downscaled and re-encoded. Free, no signup; the file is deleted right after.
- [Convert image](https://tanod.dev/tools/convert-image/): Convert PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP and AVIF images to PNG, JPG or WebP in your browser. Pick a background for transparency. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Convert images to WebP](https://tanod.dev/tools/image-to-webp/): Convert PNG and JPG images to WebP in your browser. Set the quality, see how much smaller each file gets, download one or a zip. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [Countdown timer](https://tanod.dev/tools/countdown-timer/): Free online countdown timer with presets, a sound when time is up, the time in the tab title, and a date mode that counts down to any moment in any time zone.
- [CRA 24-hour incident clock](https://tanod.dev/tools/cra-incident-clock/): Enter when you became aware of an exploited vulnerability or severe incident to get the Cyber Resilience Act deadlines (24 h, 72 h, final report) and a checklist.
- [Cron expression explainer](https://tanod.dev/tools/cron-expression-explainer/): Paste a cron expression to read it in plain English and see its next run times in your time zone, UTC or any other. Checks each field and explains errors.
- [Cron expression generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/cron-expression-generator/): Build a five-field cron schedule with presets and point-and-click controls, see it in plain English and check its next run times in any time zone before you use it.
- [Crop image](https://tanod.dev/tools/crop-image/): Crop a JPG, PNG or WebP in your browser. Drag the box, use aspect presets or type exact pixel values. Nothing is uploaded and the format is kept.
- [Crosswind and headwind calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/crosswind-calculator/): Enter a runway and the wind to get the headwind or tailwind and the crosswind component, with gusts, for both runway ends. Knots, km/h, mph or m/s.
- [CSS gradient generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/css-gradient-generator/): Build linear, radial and conic CSS gradients with a live preview, editable colour stops and presets, then copy the background rule. Free, runs in your browser.
- [CSS minifier and beautifier](https://tanod.dev/tools/css-minifier/): Minify CSS to cut file size, or beautify it to read it. Strings, url() and calc() are protected, and the result is checked against your browser's parser.
- [CSV to JSON converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/csv-to-json/): Convert CSV to JSON in your browser. Handles quoted fields, line breaks inside cells, semicolon and tab delimiters, and header rows. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [Date calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/date-calculator/): Add or subtract years, months, weeks, days or business days from any date, and get the weekday, ISO week number and day of the year of the result.
- [Days between dates](https://tanod.dev/tools/date-difference-calculator/): Count the days, weeks, months and business days between two dates, with optional times. Add or subtract days, weeks, months or years from a date.
- [Density altitude and pressure altitude calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/density-altitude-calculator/): Work out pressure altitude and density altitude from field elevation, altimeter setting and temperature, using the ISA standard atmosphere.
- [e-Fatura / UBL-TR viewer](https://tanod.dev/tools/e-fatura-ubl-tr-viewer/): Open a Turkish e-Fatura or e-Arşiv invoice (UBL-TR XML) and read it as a normal invoice. Print, save as PDF or export JSON. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [Edit PDF metadata](https://tanod.dev/tools/edit-pdf-metadata/): View and edit a PDF's title, author, subject, keywords and dates, or strip all metadata before sharing. Runs in your browser, free, and your file is never uploaded.
- [Extract emails and URLs](https://tanod.dev/tools/extract-emails-and-urls/): Extract email addresses, URLs, domains, IPs, phone numbers and hashtags from text. Remove duplicates, count, copy or download as CSV. Free, in your browser.
- [Extract pages from a PDF](https://tanod.dev/tools/extract-pdf-pages/): Pick pages from a PDF by clicking thumbnails or typing ranges, and save them as a new PDF. Works in your browser; the file is never uploaded.
- [FatturaPA viewer](https://tanod.dev/tools/fatturapa-viewer/): Open an Italian FatturaPA invoice (XML or signed .p7m) and read it as a normal invoice. Print, save as PDF or export JSON. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Favicon generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/favicon-generator/): Make a favicon from an image or a letter. Get favicon.ico, PNG sizes, an Apple touch icon, Android icons and a web manifest in one zip. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Find and replace text](https://tanod.dev/tools/find-and-replace/): Find and replace text in your browser with match case, whole word and optional regular expressions with $1 groups. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [Flight distance calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/flight-distance-calculator/): Great-circle distance between two airports (IATA or ICAO code) or two coordinates, in km, nautical miles and miles, with bearing, midpoint and flight time.
- [Fraction calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/fraction-calculator/): Add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions, mixed numbers and decimals with exact answers, steps, mixed-number form and repeating decimals. Also simplifies.
- [GIF maker](https://tanod.dev/tools/gif-maker/): Make an animated GIF from several images in your browser: set the order, frame delay and size, preview it and download. Free, no signup, nothing is uploaded.
- [Hash generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/hash-generator/): Get the MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hash of text or a file, in hex or Base64, and check it against an expected checksum. Runs in your browser.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://tanod.dev/tools/heic-to-jpg/): Convert HEIC and HEIF photos from an iPhone or Android phone to JPG in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, no signup, free. Convert many and get a zip.
- [HTML entity encoder and decoder](https://tanod.dev/tools/html-entity-encoder-decoder/): Encode text to named or numeric HTML entities, or only the unsafe < > & " ' characters, and decode any entity back to text. Free, in your browser.
- [HTML formatter](https://tanod.dev/tools/html-formatter/): Indent and tidy HTML in your browser. Handles void tags, inline scripts and styles, and keeps pre and textarea content as typed. Free, with no upload.
- [HTML to Markdown converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/html-to-markdown/): Convert HTML to clean Markdown in your browser: headings, lists, links, code blocks and tables. Choose the Markdown style. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [HTTP status codes](https://tanod.dev/tools/http-status-codes/): Searchable list of every IANA-registered HTTP status code, from 100 to 511, with what it means, when you see it, what to do as a client or server owner, and its RFC.
- [Image color picker](https://tanod.dev/tools/image-color-picker/): Pick colours from any image: click a pixel to get its HEX, RGB and HSL code, and see the image's main colour palette. Runs in your browser, no upload.
- [Image filters](https://tanod.dev/tools/image-filters/): Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation and hue, or turn a photo black and white, sepia, inverted or blurred. Live preview, runs in your browser.
- [Image to Base64](https://tanod.dev/tools/image-to-base64/): Convert a PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG image to Base64: a data URL, CSS background, HTML img tag or Markdown, ready to copy. Runs in your browser, no upload.
- [Image to text (OCR)](https://tanod.dev/tools/image-to-text/): Copy the text out of a photo, scan or screenshot with OCR. Works with JPG, PNG and WebP. Free, no signup; the image is deleted right after.
- [Invisible character detector and ASCII smuggling decoder](https://tanod.dev/tools/invisible-character-detector/): Find zero-width, bidi and Unicode tag characters, decode hidden ASCII text and spot lookalike words. Copy a cleaned version. Free, in your browser.
- [JPG to PDF](https://tanod.dev/tools/jpg-to-pdf/): Turn JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF or BMP images into one PDF in your browser. Reorder pages, pick the page size and margins, and download. Free, no signup, nothing uploaded.
- [JPG to PNG](https://tanod.dev/tools/jpg-to-png/): Convert JPG or JPEG photos to PNG in your browser, one at a time or in a batch. Lossless output for editing, no upload, no signup and no watermark.
- [JSON formatter and validator](https://tanod.dev/tools/json-formatter/): Format, minify and validate JSON in your browser. Errors show the exact line and column with a caret under the problem. Sort keys, copy or download. Free, private.
- [JSON to CSV converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/json-to-csv/): Convert a JSON array to CSV in your browser. Nested objects become dot.path columns, quoting is handled, and there is an Excel option. Nothing is uploaded.
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://tanod.dev/tools/json-to-typescript/): Paste a JSON sample and get TypeScript interfaces or types, with nested objects named, optional fields detected and unions for mixed arrays. Runs in your browser.
- [JSON to YAML converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/json-to-yaml/): Convert JSON to YAML in your browser. Values like yes, null and 012 are quoted so they stay strings, and the result is read back to confirm it matches.
- [Julian date, MJD and GPS week converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/julian-date-converter/): Convert between a calendar date and time (UTC), Julian date, Modified Julian date, GPS week and seconds of week, and Unix time. Shows the GPS week rollover.
- [JWT decoder](https://tanod.dev/tools/jwt-decoder/): Decode a JSON Web Token in your browser: header, payload and claims, with exp, nbf and iat as dates and time left until expiry. The token is not sent anywhere.
- [KSeF invoice viewer](https://tanod.dev/tools/ksef-viewer/): Open a Polish KSeF invoice (FA(3) or FA(2) XML) and read it as a normal invoice. Print, save as PDF or export JSON. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [Light-time and signal delay calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/light-time-calculator/): How long light or a radio signal takes to travel from Earth to the Moon, Sun, planets or any distance you enter, one way and round trip.
- [Loan calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/loan-calculator/): Loan and mortgage calculator: monthly payment, total interest and a full amortization schedule you can download as CSV. Free, in your browser.
- [Lorem ipsum generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator/): Generate lorem ipsum placeholder text by paragraphs, sentences or words, optionally starting with the classic line and wrapped in p tags. Free, in your browser.
- [Make a scanned PDF searchable (OCR)](https://tanod.dev/tools/ocr-pdf/): Make a scanned PDF searchable: OCR adds an invisible text layer so you can search, select and copy the text. Free, no signup; the file is deleted right after.
- [Markdown table generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/markdown-table-generator/): Build a GitHub Markdown table in an editable grid or paste CSV and spreadsheet cells, set alignment and copy it. Free, in your browser.
- [Markdown to HTML converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/markdown-to-html/): Convert Markdown to clean HTML in your browser, with GitHub-style tables, task lists and a live preview. Unsafe HTML is removed. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [Merge images](https://tanod.dev/tools/merge-images/): Combine 2 to 20 pictures into one image: side by side, stacked or in a grid, with gaps, alignment and a background colour. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Merge PDF files](https://tanod.dev/tools/merge-pdf/): Combine several PDFs into one file in your browser. Put them in any order, then download. Free, no signup, no watermark, and your files are never uploaded.
- [Meta tag generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/meta-tag-generator/): Generate HTML meta tags for title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph and Twitter cards, with length guidance and previews. Free, runs in your browser.
- [METAR and TAF decoder](https://tanod.dev/tools/metar-taf-decoder/): Paste a raw METAR, SPECI or TAF and get a plain-language breakdown: wind, visibility, weather, clouds, temperature, pressure and flight category.
- [Mexico CFDI viewer](https://tanod.dev/tools/cfdi-viewer/): Open a Mexican CFDI (XML) and read it as a normal invoice, with the UUID and a Verify with SAT link. Print, save as PDF or export JSON. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [MikroTik address list generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-address-list-generator/): Turn a list of IPs, CIDRs and ranges into a RouterOS firewall address-list script. Removes duplicates, merges overlapping networks, IPv4 and IPv6, optional timeout.
- [MikroTik burst calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-burst-calculator/): See how long a RouterOS queue bursts with your max-limit, burst-limit, burst-threshold and burst-time, with a rate chart and ready queue and PPP rate-limit lines.
- [MikroTik DHCP server generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-dhcp-server-generator/): Generate a RouterOS DHCP server: IP pool, server, network settings (gateway, DNS, domain, NTP) and static leases, checked against the subnet. Runs in your browser.
- [MikroTik firewall auditor](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-firewall-auditor/): Paste a RouterOS /export to find common hardening gaps: input chain without a final drop, exposed WinBox or SSH, open DNS resolver, proxy, shadowed rules and more.
- [MikroTik firewall generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-firewall-generator/): Build a hardened RouterOS v7 firewall: input and forward chains, FastTrack, invalid drop, rate-limited ping, NAT and service lockdown. Runs in your browser.
- [MikroTik load balancing and failover generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-load-balancing/): Generate RouterOS v7 PCC load balancing over 2 to 8 WANs with recursive failover, check hosts, routing tables and masquerade. Commented, in your browser.
- [MikroTik Netwatch generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-netwatch-generator/): Generate a RouterOS /tool netwatch script that watches your hosts and sends ntfy, Telegram or e-mail alerts when they go down or come back. In your browser.
- [MikroTik PCQ generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-pcq-generator/): Generate RouterOS PCQ queue types plus a simple queue or a queue tree with mangle marks, so every client gets a fair, capped share of the link. In your browser.
- [MikroTik port forwarding generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-port-forwarding/): Write RouterOS dst-nat port forwarding rules for TCP and UDP, with optional hairpin NAT and source restrictions. Validated, commented, and generated in your browser.
- [MikroTik PPPoE server generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-pppoe-server-generator/): Generate a RouterOS PPPoE server: address pool, speed-plan profiles with rate-limit, the server, placeholder secrets, optional RADIUS and NAT. In your browser.
- [MikroTik simple queue generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-simple-queue-generator/): Generate RouterOS simple queues per IP or for every host in a subnet: max-limit, limit-at, burst and a parent queue for the total plan. Commented, in your browser.
- [MikroTik VLAN generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-vlan-generator/): Generate RouterOS v7 bridge VLAN filtering: access, trunk and hybrid ports, bridge VLAN table, VLAN interfaces and addresses, enabled last to avoid lock-out.
- [MikroTik WireGuard generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/mikrotik-wireguard-generator/): Generate a RouterOS v7 WireGuard server and ready peer configs. Keys are created in your browser with Web Crypto and never leave your device.
- [Moon phase calendar](https://tanod.dev/tools/moon-phase-calendar/): A month calendar of moon phases and illumination for every day, with the exact times of new moon, first quarter, full moon and last quarter in your time zone.
- [Morse code translator](https://tanod.dev/tools/morse-code-translator/): Translate text to Morse code and Morse code back to text, with letters, digits and punctuation. Play it as sound at the speed you choose. Runs in your browser.
- [Number base converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/number-base-converter/): Convert whole numbers between binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal and any base from 2 to 36, of any size, with two's complement for 8, 16, 32 and 64 bits.
- [Number to words](https://tanod.dev/tools/number-to-words/): Write numbers, ordinals and cheque amounts in English words for USD, EUR, GBP, PHP, INR and more. Exact for huge numbers. Free, in your browser.
- [Password generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/password-generator/): Create strong random passwords in your browser. Pick the length and character sets, see the entropy, and copy. Nothing is sent or stored. Free, no signup.

- [Satellite orbital period and altitude calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/orbital-period-calculator/): Find the orbital period and speed of a satellite from its altitude, or the altitude for a given period, using Kepler's third law for circular Earth orbits.
- [Save a web page as PDF](https://tanod.dev/tools/url-to-pdf/): Save a web page as a PDF from its address. Pick A4 or Letter, portrait or landscape. Free, no signup, no extension; the PDF is deleted from our server right after.
- [Scientific calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/scientific-calculator/): A scientific calculator with brackets, powers, factorials, trig in degrees or radians, logs and roots. Type or tap, see the working in history, no sign-up.
- [security.txt generator and checker](https://tanod.dev/tools/security-txt-generator/): Write a security.txt for /.well-known/ with the right fields, or paste yours to check it against RFC 9116: Contact, Expires, https links, Canonical and signatures.
- [Sign a PDF](https://tanod.dev/tools/sign-pdf/): Sign a PDF in your browser: draw or type your signature, place it on any page, add the date and save. Free, no signup, and the file never leaves your device.
- [Sort lines alphabetically](https://tanod.dev/tools/sort-lines-alphabetically/): Sort a list of lines alphabetically, in natural number order, by length or at random. Ignore case, drop duplicates and empty lines. Free, runs in your browser.
- [Split a PDF](https://tanod.dev/tools/split-pdf/): Split a PDF into several files by page ranges, every N pages, or one file per page. Runs in your browser: free, no signup, nothing uploaded.
- [SQL formatter](https://tanod.dev/tools/sql-formatter/): Format and beautify SQL for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, BigQuery and more. Choose keyword case and indent. Runs in your browser, free.
- [Stopwatch](https://tanod.dev/tools/stopwatch/): A free online stopwatch with lap and split times, fastest and slowest laps marked, keyboard shortcuts, and copy or CSV download. Accurate to a hundredth of a second.
- [Subnet calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/subnet-calculator/): Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address with a prefix or mask to get the network, broadcast, host range, counts, wildcard mask and binary view, and split it into subnets.
- [Sunrise, sunset, twilight and moon phase calculator](https://tanod.dev/tools/sunrise-sunset-calculator/): Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, civil, nautical and astronomical twilight, moonrise, moonset and moon phase for any place and date, calculated in your browser.
- [SVG to PNG](https://tanod.dev/tools/svg-to-png/): Convert an SVG to a sharp PNG at 1x, 2x, 4x or an exact width, with a transparent or coloured background. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
- [Text to binary converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/text-to-binary/): Convert text to binary code and binary back to text, using UTF-8 so accents and emoji work. Hex, decimal and octal bytes too. Free, runs in your browser.
- [Text to speech](https://tanod.dev/tools/text-to-speech/): Paste text and have it read aloud with the voices already on your device. Choose a voice, speed, pitch and volume, and follow along word by word. Free, no sign-up.
- [Time zone converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/time-zone-converter/): Convert a date and time to many time zones at once, with UTC offsets, day changes, daylight saving gaps and overlaps, and an hourly meeting planner.
- [Unit converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/unit-converter/): Convert length, weight, temperature, volume, area and speed between metric, US and imperial units, using exact defined factors. Every unit shown at once.
- [Unix timestamp converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/unix-timestamp-converter/): Convert Unix timestamps in seconds, milliseconds, microseconds or nanoseconds to dates in UTC or any time zone, and dates back to epoch time. Free, in your browser.
- [Unlock a PDF](https://tanod.dev/tools/unlock-pdf/): Remove the password and print or copy restrictions from a PDF, using the password you know. Free, no signup; the file and password are deleted right after.
- [URL encode and decode](https://tanod.dev/tools/url-encode-decode/): Percent-encode or decode text for URLs: component, full URL or form encoding, UTF-8 safe, with clear errors for broken escapes. Also splits a URL into its parts.
- [URL slug generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/text-to-slug/): Turn a title into a clean URL slug: lower case, accents converted, hyphens or underscores, optional length limit. One slug per line. Runs in your browser.
- [User agent parser](https://tanod.dev/tools/user-agent-parser/): See what your browser's user agent says, or paste any string, and get the browser, engine, OS, device and CPU, plus Client Hints and why Chrome hides detail.
- [UUID generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/uuid-generator/): Generate random version 4 or time-ordered version 7 UUIDs in bulk, copy or download them, and check what version and timestamp a UUID holds. Free, in your browser.
- [vCard QR code generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/vcard-qr-code-generator/): Turn contact details into a vCard QR code that phones scan to save a contact. Download PNG, SVG or a .vcf file and see the exact vCard text. Free, in your browser.
- [Vietnam e-invoice viewer](https://tanod.dev/tools/vietnam-e-invoice-viewer/): Open a Vietnamese hóa đơn điện tử (XML) and read it as a normal invoice. Print, save as PDF or export JSON. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [Vulnerability disclosure policy generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/vulnerability-disclosure-policy-generator/): Fill in a short form to get a plain-language coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy as Markdown and HTML: scope, contact, response times, safe harbour.
- [WebP to PNG](https://tanod.dev/tools/webp-to-png/): Convert WebP images saved from websites into PNG files any app can open. Transparency is kept. Works in your browser, nothing is uploaded, no signup.
- [Wi-Fi QR code generator](https://tanod.dev/tools/wifi-qr-code-generator/): Make a QR code that lets guests join your Wi-Fi by scanning it. Choose security and hidden networks, then download PNG, SVG or a printable card. Free, in-browser.
- [Word counter](https://tanod.dev/tools/word-counter/): Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you type. Reading time, keyword density and readability scores. Free, no signup, nothing is uploaded.
- [Word frequency counter](https://tanod.dev/tools/word-frequency-counter/): Find the most common words and two or three-word phrases in a text with counts and percentages, skip stop words and download CSV. Free.
- [x402 listing lint](https://tanod.dev/tools/x402-listing-lint/): Paste an x402 PaymentRequired JSON and check it against the CDP Bazaar listing rules: description length, when-to-use sentence, https, outputSchema, payTo.
- [XML formatter and validator](https://tanod.dev/tools/xml-formatter/): Pretty-print, minify and validate XML in your browser. Errors show line and column. Entities, CDATA and mixed content are never rewritten. Free and private.
- [XRechnung viewer](https://tanod.dev/tools/xrechnung-viewer/): Open an XRechnung (UBL or CII XML) and read it as a normal invoice. Print it, save it as PDF or export JSON. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [YAML to JSON converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/yaml-to-json/): Convert YAML to JSON in your browser. Supports anchors, aliases, merge keys and multi-document files, with line and column for errors. Free and private.
- [ZUGFeRD / Factur-X viewer](https://tanod.dev/tools/zugferd-factur-x-viewer/): Take the XML invoice out of a ZUGFeRD or Factur-X PDF and read it as a normal invoice. Print or export JSON. Free, nothing is uploaded.
- [Zulu time (UTC) converter](https://tanod.dev/tools/zulu-time-converter/): Convert local time to Zulu (UTC) and back for any time zone, with METAR-style DDHHMMZ time groups. Uses your browser's time zone database.

## Other languages

Every tool is also available in Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Turkish, Vietnamese, Russian, Polish and Hindi; see the sitemaps listed in https://tanod.dev/robots.txt.
